_instructions: Fill in the real Google Business Profile resource name for each centre below, once you know it. You'll get these from the Business Profile API itself — see scripts/list-locations.js, which you can run after Google API access is approved to print each location's exact resource name (looks like 'accounts/1234567890/locations/9876543210'). Replace the empty 'name' values with those, one per centre. Do not change the keys (alwarpet / thoraipakkam / borewell-road) — they must match the centre ids used everywhere else in the dashboard.
